integrity: The determinant identity, cross-ratio numerator, symbolic projective-orbit vanishing, Hessian rank certificate, and sample smooth/singular points are checked by exact symbolic arithmetic in the supplied verifier. The normality and transverse A1 conclusions additionally use the written algebraic proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for four translational collinear cameras with pairwise distinct complex parameters; colliding centers are excluded.
The singularity classification concerns the correction divisor inside the determinantal baseline component, not the complete singular locus of the full line multiview variety.

Classical PGL(2) orbit-closure theory is broader background; the asserted contribution is the camera-correction identification together with the explicit singular-locus and transverse-type calculation.
title: Cross-ratio geometry and nodal singularities of the four-collinear line-multiview correction
